headline: Live Events Operations Lead
profile: Live events and operations leader with 15 years' experience delivering world-class events in high-profile public environments, from theatre and TV studios to heading Esports Operations at BLAST. Led a six-person department running tournament and event operations across 60+ flagship events and 300+ qualifiers in 13 countries, with €12m+ in budgets and 2,000+ freelancers booked and managed. Experienced in safety and operational standards, contingency planning, budget monitoring and managing external suppliers and specialist contractors, alongside stakeholder management with partners, regulators and venue teams. Hands-on with event logistics, equipment and freelancer booking, and built the operations tools and documentation behind a fast-moving events calendar. Looking to bring that operational discipline to events and brand activations in a high-profile public setting.

jobs.title: Head of Esports Operations
bullets: Led a six-person department running tournament operations across every BLAST ecosystem, including CS2, Dota 2, Brawl Stars, Fortnite, Rocket League and Rainbow Six
Wrote the business case for a departmental OPEX budget covering equipment renewal, software and cross-event costs, with risk and budget monitoring built in
Rebuilt how the department works, with clearer ownership, accountability and proper documentation
Designed and built the department's own tools for event and equipment tracking, freelancer and contractor bookings, and event budgets and deadlines
Costed and pitched new tournament work with the product and commercial teams
Set technical requirements for commercial partnerships
Brought Team Operations into the department, so all online and offline player management and support sat with one team

jobs.title: Tournament Operations Manager
bullets: Managed tournament equipment and staffing budgets across CS:GO, Dota 2, Apex Legends, FIFA, Fortnite and Rainbow Six
Booked and managed tournament operations freelancers and specialist contractors for internal, external and online productions
Main tournament-level contact for FACEIT, ESIC and BLAST Premier teams
Approved equipment and staffing invoices, and decided when to hire, buy or repair tournament kit
Arranged venues and equipment for team bootcamps
Designated Safeguarding Lead and first aider at live events

jobs.title: Broadcast Freelancer
bullets: Crewed broadcasts and live events for clients including BLAST Pro Series, ESL UK and ESL Germany, BBC, Sky Sports, ITV, Immediate Media, NATS, Big Ben (WRC), Altitude Angels and Create Broadcasting
Worked in the gallery as technical director, producer and graphics operator on live shows
On-stage admin at esports events, and consulted on production and technical setups for clients

jobs.title: Broadcast and Studio Manager
bullets: Managed suppliers, invoice approval and day-to-day maintenance, including software and hardware updates
Designed a multi-camera TV studio from scratch, bought the equipment, and managed installation and testing
Controlled the studio budget, including equipment purchasing
Hired freelancers and ran staff rotas to keep a 24-hour TV channel on air, including holiday cover and emergency call-outs
Trained staff on studio equipment and workflows

jobs.title: Production Manager
bullets: Managed production for both studios and at external events including MCM, EGX and Formula E
Built and set up the technical infrastructure for two ESL UK studios
Controlled production budgets and purchased studio and event equipment
Hired freelance crew, managed rotas and supervised internal and external staff on live shows
Worked in the gallery as technical director, producer and graphics operator on live broadcasts
Trained crew on equipment and workflows, and ran equipment hire, installation, testing and maintenance

jobs.title: Senior Lighting and Event Technician
bullets: Set up and ran touring and in-house performances
Controlled the equipment and training budget, and ran in-house lighting training
Maintained specialist kit for a theatre and two cinemas, from lighting and audio desks to 35mm and digital projectors
Carried out PAT testing on the venue's electrical equipment
Covered whatever the show needed, working as audio engineer, stage hand or stage manager
Head of lighting for The Darkness's support act, support lighting engineer for Enter Shikari, head of audio and lighting for Lee Mack, and comedy tours with Jimmy Carr, Dara Ó Briain and Ed Byrne
